name: marker
title: Marker
description: A highlighter stroke across the one phrase in a paragraph a reader should not miss. The first time the phrase scrolls into view, the stroke sweeps across it from the start of the line to the end, the way a pen would, and wraps across lines with the text.…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/marker

Installed to `components/ui/effects/marker.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/marker';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/marker

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
